groups.investigation: Trace actual interior search and rank reached consequence positions across failures and successes; separate missing continuation from incorrect evaluation.
groups.possible_correction: Only a demonstrated general search/value-propagation defect or supported classical threat/coordination correction.

groups.behavior: Timing of pawn advances, promotion, king activity, piece coverage and liquidation
groups.cause_status: Not established. Pawn-race horizon, checking defenses, promotion transitions and positional judgment remain alternatives.
groups.investigation: Contrast immediate push/promotion cases with support/king-activation cases using full histories and claim state.
groups.possible_correction: General passed-pawn/blockade/king-activity/exchange judgment or focused continuation coverage, conditional on results.

groups.investigation: Reuse prepared and unaided cases with MSH-160 (Chess Opening Quality Assessment); test concrete consequences.
groups.possible_correction: General central-tension/development correction only if supported; no book-first or family-blacklist recommendation.
